The '''Elite Senate Guard''' were a chosen few selected of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] whose responsibilities included [[Bodyguard/Legends|protection]] of important [[Senator/Legends|senators]]. They often accompanied the senators to their home planet and back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], ensuring their safe passage. They also conducted investigations, working alongside the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. They wore robes consisting of the same distinctive blue worn by the Senate Guard and the [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]], and wielded a [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifle]] outfitted with a [[stun bayonet]].
